issue_request: FHIR-36240 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Consent and requested a root Consent.period element with cardinality 0..1, short text 'Effective period for this Consent', and a definition saying it applies to the Consent resource and all provisions unless a provision specifies otherwise.

additional_context: Consent is active in source/fhir.ini. The parent FHIR-31910 issue records the original overall-period question and split this request into FHIR-36240. Later Consent changes already on the combined branch updated Consent.provision.period to refer readers to Consent.period for consent-wide effective time; later provision search-parameter work remained scoped to provision periods and does not require a FHIR-36240 change.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml defines Consent.period 0..1 as Period with the approved short and definition, and the neighboring provision.period comment no longer forces consent-wide period semantics into a provision.
